title: Ayna Çekim Portresi
prompt: Reimagine the uploaded selfie as a playful vintage-cafe mirror portrait photographed with a strong fisheye lens. Preserve the adult subject's recognizable face, hair, skin tone, age, and gender presentation. Keep the subject and phone naturally reflected in one large round mirror while the cafe curves dramatically around the frame: tiled floor, small wooden tables, warm pendant lights, and a turquoise accent wall. Use authentic 1990s film color, mild grain, realistic reflections, and lively but believable wide-angle distortion that does not warp the face. One standalone photograph, no split screen, no collage, no extra people, no readable signage, logos, or watermark. 1:1 image ratio.

title: Hayalimdeki Aile Portresi
prompt:
Create a heartwarming, highly realistic portrait of the user's dream family, based on everything you know about the user from their previous conversations, memories, personality, interests, values, lifestyle, and aspirations.
Include the user, their imagined ideal life partner, and a possible future child or children, along with a pet if it fits their lifestyle. Preserve the user's recognizable appearance if a reference photo is provided. Create a natural, emotionally warm family scene that reflects the user's personality and vision of happiness, using realistic details, cinematic lighting, and a visually appealing composition.
Add small, handwritten-style annotations around the image with arrows, doodles, and subtle decorative elements. Highlight each family member's imagined personality traits, hobbies, interests, clothing style, and distinctive characteristics. Include a few short notes about the family's shared lifestyle, dreams, and values.
Language requirement: Detect the language the user most commonly uses when communicating with you, based on the available conversation history. Write ALL text appearing inside the image—including headings, labels, annotations, and handwritten notes—in that language. Do not default to English or use multiple languages unless the user's usual communication naturally includes them. If the preferred language cannot be determined, use the language of the user's latest message.
Make the image feel personal, authentic, affectionate, and specific to the user rather than generic. Treat imagined family members and their characteristics as creative possibilities, not established facts. Keep annotations short, legible, grammatically correct, and naturally phrased in the detected language. Ensure the text does not obscure faces or important details.
High-resolution, photorealistic, cohesive composition, natural expressions, realistic anatomy, warm atmosphere, detailed environment, elegant handwritten typography, and a polished final image. No watermarks or unnecessary text.

title: Hamam Böceği Kız Karakteri
prompt:
Create a highly detailed 3D cartoon-style anthropomorphic female cockroach-human hybrid character.
She has a beautiful human face with [yüz tanımı: örneğin “realistic features resembling a young woman with brown eyes, natural makeup, darker lipstick”], shoulder-length dark wavy hair, and two long brown cockroach antennae coming out of her head.
She is wearing professional corporate business attire: a black blazer over a white button-up shirt and a tight black mini skirt. Her arms are smooth human arms (no hair or spikes), and her legs are smooth, hairless human legs visible below the skirt.
The lower body still shows glossy brown cockroach elements (exoskeleton segments, wings, and extra insect legs) partially visible around and behind the skirt.
She is posing in a pink-tiled modern bathroom, holding a pink smartphone to her ear with one hand while the other hand touches her face.
She has colorful vibrant nail art on her fingernails.
A small black “AMOR” tattoo is visible on her upper chest.
Soft even lighting, highly detailed, glossy textures, cute yet slightly creepy aesthetic.
Add the text “[İSİM]” in pink letters on the upper left wall (replaceable watermark).

title: Çift Fotokabin Kolajı
prompt:
Create a high-resolution, photorealistic vertical 1:1 photobooth collage featuring three different close-up couple poses in a stylish, dimly lit studio with a brushed-metal background.
Female outfit: Modern fitted cropped camisole with thin straps and a tasteful low neckline, paired with fashionable casual bottoms, delicate silver rings, glossy nude nails, and shiny lip gloss.
Male outfit: Oversized sleeveless T-shirt in a casual streetwear style, showcasing his strong, muscular arms, paired with relaxed modern trousers and dark sunglasses.
Frame 1: The woman gently cups the man's cheek while they look at each other closely, creating a confident, intimate atmosphere.
Frame 2: The woman gives him a soft kiss on the side of his neck while he smiles subtly and places his hand gently on her waist.
Frame 3: They share a romantic kiss, with the woman's hand resting on his jaw and the man's arm loosely around her waist.
Natural skin texture, realistic facial details, sharp focus, soft intimate lighting, subtle shadows, modern fashion editorial aesthetic, natural expressions, consistent faces and outfits across all three frames, elegant sensual chemistry, realistic photography, no distortion, no text, no watermark, no logo.
